description: Run the @buzzr/dfs-engine runtime validators against a candidate DFS entry. Returns ok plus structured error/warning issues (code, message, path, legIds) without settling anything.

entry.description: A candidate DfsEntryInput object (entryId, bookId, playTypeId, stake, displayedMultiplier, legs[]). Passed as-is to the engine validators so malformed entries return structured issues instead of schema rejections.

name: validate_dfs_entry
title: Validate DFS entry
